thread.title: U.S. shares higher at close of trade; Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.70%

author: Investing.com
title: U.S. shares higher at close of trade; Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.70%
text:
© Reuters. U.S. shares higher at close of trade; Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.70% Investing.com – U.S. equities were higher at the close on Monday, as gains in the Technology , Industrials and Consumer Services sectors propelled shares higher.
At the close in NYSE, the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.70% to hit a new 1-month high, while the S&P 500 index added 0.68%, and the NASDAQ Composite index climbed 1.15%.
The biggest gainers of the session on the Dow Jones Industrial Average were Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ), which rose 2.88% or 2.96 points to trade at 105.74 at the close. Apple Inc (NASDAQ: AAPL ) added 2.84% or 4.73 points to end at 171.25 and Boeing Co (NYSE: BA ) was up 2.47% or 9.57 points to 397.00 in late trade.
Biggest losers included Exxon Mobil Corp (NYSE: XOM ), which lost 1.45% or 1.10 points to trade at 74.82 in late trade. Pfizer Inc (NYSE: PFE ) declined 1.03% or 0.44 points to end at 42.44 and Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ ) shed 0.98% or 1.32 points to 132.88.
The top performers on the S&P 500 were KKR & Co LP (F: KR51 ) which rose 6.42% to 20.72, Clorox Co (NYSE: CLX ) which was up 5.69% to settle at 158.38 and Raytheon Company (NYSE: RTN ) which gained 5.24% to close at 174.65.
The worst performers were Allergan PLC (NYSE: AGN ) which was down 3.85% to 138.53 in late trade, Electronic Arts Inc (NASDAQ: EA ) which lost 3.06% to settle at 88.43 and AbbVie Inc (NYSE: ABBV ) which was down 2.45% to 78.530 at the close.
The top performers on the NASDAQ Composite were Cempra Inc (NASDAQ: MLNT ) which rose 71.18% to 1.460, Top Image Systems Ltd (NASDAQ: TISA ) which was up 55.43% to settle at 0.830 and Maxwell Technologies Inc (NASDAQ: MXWL ) which gained 49.51% to close at 4.59.
The worst performers were Check Cap Ltd (NASDAQ: CHEK ) which was down 27.62% to 2.490 in late trade, OHR Pharmaceutical Inc (NASDAQ: OHRP ) which lost 23.05% to settle at 1.970 and TMSR Holding Company Ltd (NASDAQ: TMSR ) which was down 18.84% to 4.48 at the close.
Advancing stocks outnumbered falling ones by 2035 to 974 and 115 ended unchanged; on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange, 1806 rose and 831 declined, while 76 ended unchanged on the New York Stock Exchange.
The CBOE Volatility Index , which measures the implied volatility of S&P 500 options, was down 2.54% to 15.73 a new 3-month low.
In commodities trading, Gold Futures for April delivery was down 0.43% or 5.65 to $1316.45 a troy ounce. Meanwhile, Crude oil for delivery in March fell 0.96% or 0.53 to hit $54.73 a barrel, while the April Brent oil contract fell 0.22% or 0.14 to trade at $62.61 a barrel.
EUR/USD was down 0.15% to 1.1437, while USD/JPY rose 0.41% to 109.92.
The US Dollar Index Futures was up 0.28% at 95.567.
U.S. shares higher at close of trade; Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.70%
